request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
Can I still object to the higher health insurance contribution? Until when?

response.text:
Yes — you can still object. The to-do "Decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to the contribution notice" from Muster BKK is open, with the objection due by **Wed 14 Oct 2026**, and Ordnung recommends sending it by **Thu 8 Oct 2026** to arrive in time [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

A few things to keep in mind:
- The objection (Widerspruch) must be filed in writing or electronically with Muster BKK by that due date [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- Even if you object, the contribution must still be paid at the assessed amount in the meantime, since an objection has no suspensive effect (keine aufschiebende Wirkung) [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

The underlying letter is the "Notice of increased health and long-term care insurance contribution (Beitragsbescheid)" from Muster BKK [doc:doc_9t9tmrv1ypba]. You can draft the objection letter from this to-do in Ordnung; I can't send it for you.
